core_struggle: His business has suffered heavy losses and debt has piled up; with children's fees due, he cannot sleep and cannot tell anyone.
mirror: You lie awake with the numbers and the children's fees, and you cannot bring yourself to say it out loud.

queries.hook: The weight of a failing business and mounting debt, with children's fees due, and the silence of not being able to tell anyone.
queries.diagnose: Fear grows from imagining the future and from forgetting that what is real in you cannot be lost; worry multiplies what has not happened.
queries.steady: What is real in you cannot be taken by what has happened; the effort you made is yours, and no result can take that away.
queries.act: Do your duty with the work you can control today, let the result go, and speak one true thing to one person you trust.
queries.story: A man who lost everything he built, facing his family and his own fear, yet finding the courage to stand again.

weeks: What remains when it is gone
bridge: What you are living with is what the texts call fear of what might happen, and that is where this week begins.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the sleeplessness and the debt as a fear that has a name.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the sleeplessness is the fear of what it might mean, not the debt itself.
week_beats.steady: You hold that what is real in you cannot be taken by what has happened.
week_beats.act: You try doing one thing you can control today, and saying one true thing to one person.
week_beats.story: A man who lost everything shows you what standing again looks like from the inside.

insight: The debt is real, but the sleeplessness is the fear of what it might mean for your children and your name. The two are not the same thing.
